checklist.request: The revised basin criterion correctly fixes the linear-null problem. However, the interpretation still conflates endpoint characters with next-character decision classes. The 65 endpoint characters produce only 15 distinct endpoint argmax predictions, only 32% of paths visit exactly two predictions, and the median is three. Therefore, the evidence supports character-conditioned logit-space basins whose transitions coincide with prediction changes, not “one next-character decision basin per character.” Please narrow the headline and conclusion accordingly.
